verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI exposes full message-history access that developers can use to continue conversations or inspect them, which provides the raw hooks a developer would need to implement trimming or filtering themselves, but there is no documented built-in summarization, truncation, or automatic context-window management feature. Missing for 10: explicit summarization/trim utilities, automatic context-window enforcement, and any community confirmation that context-length management works well in practice.
